title: Associate Creative Director
description:
**About Remedy Edge Spain:**



Welcome to Remedy Edge Spain. We activate potential, amplify with creativity, and accelerate outcomes. Remedy Edge brings strategic thinking and bold communications to healthcare — cutting through the noise to move people and change results. We don't do comfortable. We do cutting edge. Join us and GET THE EDGE.


**About the role:**



We are looking for an experienced **Associate Creative Director (ACD)** to join our creative international team. In this role, you will lead the development of integrated healthcare campaigns, partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative, high\-quality creative solutions from concept through execution.


**Key responsibilities:**


* Develop strong creative concepts and integrated campaigns across multiple channels and formats.
* Lead the creative development of projects from initial concept through final execution, ensuring excellence in both visual and verbal communication.
* Transform complex healthcare and scientific information into clear, engaging, and impactful creative solutions.
* Partner with Creative Directors to define and maintain the creative vision and quality of the work.
* Lead, inspire and mentor creative teams, including art directors, copywriters and designers.
* Provide clear, constructive creative feedback that elevates the overall quality of the work.
* Collaborate closely with Strategy, Account, Medical and Production teams.
* Present and defend creative ideas confidently to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines without compromising creative standards.
* Take ownership of projects, proactively identify challenges and help drive work forward efficiently.


**About you:**



A **creative leader first and foremost**: someone with exceptional conceptual thinking, strong creative instincts, and the ability to recognize, develop and elevate great ideas.



Whether your roots are in **Art, Copy, or both**, you should be comfortable overseeing and guiding all aspects of the creative process, inspiring multidisciplinary teams and taking ownership of projects from concept to execution.



We're looking for someone with the ambition to push the work forward, the creative craft to make it exceptional, and the leadership skills to bring teams along the journey and deliver outstanding results.


**Skills \& Experience**


* **7\-8 years of creative experience in healthcare communications.**
* Strong background in either **Art Direction, Copywriting, or both**, with a portfolio demonstrating outstanding conceptual thinking and creative craft.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns across a variety of channels and touchpoints.
* Strong experience working with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical or health\-related brands.
* **Native\-level English is essential.**
* **Proven ability to lead creative teams and projects.**
* Excellent conceptual thinking, communication and presentation skills.
* Strong expertise in visual storytelling, narrative development, creative strategy and content creation.
* Ability to understand complex scientific information and translate it into compelling creative communications.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Collaborative, proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.

  


*Omnicom Health is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we're focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.


### **Job Description**


Job Ref ID: JR0085668

**YOUR MISSION**


As the Head of Product Strategy \& Operations for Brands Ads, you are the strategy and scaling engine behind Glovo's fastest\-growing revenue stream. Your core challenge over the next 12\-18 months is to anchor the Go\-to\-Market roadmap between Glovo and Delivery Hero, launch best\-in\-class ad placements globally, and define the automated tools and infrastructure required to optimize campaigns at scale.

* 7\+ years of deep, specialized experience in AdTech, Digital Ads, or a marketplace advertising network.
* Elite stakeholder management skills; capable of aligning Delivery Hero Product, Glovo Product, Data, and Local Heads in a highly matrixed environment.
* Proven ability to define operational tools and scalable processes for campaign optimization, paired with strong financial planning/modeling skills.
* Experience managing hybrid teams (direct and dotted\-line reporting lines) to execute complex, cross\-functional strategic goals.

**Nice to have:**

* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce as a business owner.

title: Game Design Director - Star Trek Fleet Command
Specialist, Creative Strategy
description:
**About Darkroom**


Darkroom is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a Specialist, Creative Strategy to lead day\-to\-day creative execution for Darkroom's social programs — both paid social advertising and organic content \- across a portfolio of client accounts. You're comfortable diving into the feed and the ad account alike, giving tactical, platform\-native feedback on statics, hooks, pacing, captions, and edit structure for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram. You're likely a Creative Strategist, Social Strategist, or Video Editor by trade, with hands\-on experience shipping content that performs, not just looks good.


You'll work on our Performance Creative service — our AI\-powered creative engagement for paid and organic social — helping clients increase the diversity and volume of their creative program (upwards of 50\+ new assets per month) while keeping every piece grounded in what's actually driving hooks, watch time, and conversion.


You'll work daily alongside Designers, Editors, and Creative Strategists to keep the social and paid social creative pipeline moving — briefing assets, giving feedback, and translating client goals and platform data into concepts that ship on time and drive results.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).***

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day creative execution for paid social and organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts
* Brief and direct Designers and Editors on statics, motion, short\-form video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure
* Copywriting: Own creative copy for US\-based clients, flexing in tone of voice according to platform and purpose, threading the needle when clients ask you to “punch up the copy
* Own the testing and content calendar cadence — what ships, in what order, against what hypothesis or content pillar
* Translate platform and performance data (hook retention, watch time, CTR, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) into clear creative and content direction
* Partner with Paid Media to identify organic winners worth scaling into paid, and with Social Commerce on creator and UGC briefs
* Maintain quality and consistency across a high volume of social creative output, flagging risk to timelines or scope early
* Present creative and content work to clients and internal stakeholders with clarity and rationale
* Use AI\-assisted tools (e.g. FLORA, Midjourney, Runway, Claude) to increase the speed and volume of output

**You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You**

* 4\+ years managing or leading creative execution for paid social and/or organic social programs, ideally at an agency
* Hands\-on with short\-form video, statics, and platform\-native content for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram — you can storyboard, cut, and ship, not just direct
* Comfortable jumping into Figma, Premiere, or Photoshop yourself when needed — this isn't a strategy\-only role
* Fluent in both paid and organic metrics (CTR, hook retention, watch time, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) and use them to decide what to make next
* A clear, proactive communicator who gives crisp feedback to designers and editors and can present to clients
* Already using AI tools to speed up and scale creative production
* A portfolio showing paid and/or organic social work with real performance or engagement context

### **Hard Disqualifiers**

* No hands\-on experience shipping paid or organic social creative (design, video, or content)
* No portfolio link or no performance/engagement context
* Strategy\-only with no execution ability
* Not comfortable presenting work to clients

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**


Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love . As the largest Ortho clinic chain in Europe, we combine cutting\-edge tech with expert care, revolutionizing invisible orthodontics since 2019\.


With 150\+ clinics across 10 countries and rapid growth, we’re improving lives worldwide.


We are looking for a Head of Design to join our Onsite Team in Barcelona.

  

Why we’re cool:

* Work with an international and multicultural team
* Competitive salary
* Teeth aligner and whitening benefits
* Collaborative work environment and positive culture
* Opportunities to grow within a fast\-paced, innovative company and real start\-up experience with big challenges
* Fresh fruits and healthy snacks at the office

* Translate complex clinical and regulated processes into simple, intuitive digital flows that build patient trust and confidence.
* Own the research and insights practice — embedding qualitative and quantitative methods into the design process.
* Act as the senior design voice in cross\-functional rooms, aligning stakeholders around a clear and compelling product vision.


Requirements:

* 8\+ years in Product Design, with at least 2–3 years in a design leadership role.
* Strong portfolio showcasing end\-to\-end product design across web and mobile.
* Proven experience leading design for conversion\-driven journeys (funnels, onboarding, booking flows).
* Experience building and scaling design systems in complex product environments.
* Strong UX thinking with ability to simplify regulated or clinically complex domains.
* Hands\-on with Figma and modern design workflows.
* Experience running or overseeing user research and data\-informed design.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills.
* Fluent English — Spanish is a strong plus.

title: Social Art Director & Videographer - Madrid
description:
**¿Quiénes somos?**
-------------------


Somos una consultora internacional especializada en impulsar la evolución de los modelos de negocio de grandes y medianas empresas. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a mejorar su competitividad conectando estrategia, comunicación, diseño, tecnología y datos, siempre con un enfoque práctico y orientado a generar impacto.


Contamos con un equipo de más de 2\.000 profesionales distribuidos en distintos países y trabajamos en proyectos end\-to\-end, acompañando a nuestros clientes desde la definición estratégica hasta la implementación, la medición y la optimización continua. Nuestro objetivo es transformar los datos en decisiones de negocio que generen resultados reales.


En esta ocasión, estamos colaborando con **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, en la búsqueda de talento para incorporar a su equipo y cubrir esta posición.

**¿Qué es Cosmic?**
-------------------

**Cosmic** es una agencia especializada en **Short Vertical Video**, el formato que domina plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts. Como primer partner creativo de TikTok en Europa, ayuda a las marcas a conectar con sus audiencias a través de contenidos nativos, creativos y diseñados para maximizar su impacto.


Su equipo se encarga de diseñar, producir y optimizar contenidos que destacan en las plataformas donde hoy se generan las conversaciones y las tendencias, combinando creatividad, estrategia y un profundo conocimiento del ecosistema digital.

### **¿Qué buscamos?**

**¿Sabes que un buen TikTok no es un spot de 30 segundos puesto en vertical?**


Buscamos un/a **Social Art Director \& Videographer** con un ojo creativo brutal y una sensibilidad especial por el lenguaje de cada plataforma. Alguien que entienda qué hace que una idea funcione en social y que sea capaz de llevarla de principio a fin: **conceptualizarla, grabarla, editarla y convertirla en contenido que la gente quiera ver y compartir.**


No buscamos solo a alguien que sepa hacer vídeos bonitos. Buscamos a alguien que **entienda el lenguaje de internet, tenga criterio visual y sepa convertir una buena idea en contenido que funcione.**

### **Eres perfecto/a si**

* **Tienes 3\+ años de experiencia** en dirección de arte, diseño creativo o creación audiovisual, idealmente en agencia creativa, digital, productora o entorno social\-first.
* **Tu portfolio habla por ti.** Demuestra criterio visual, buenas ideas y, sobre todo, capacidad real para llevarlas a ejecución.
* **Tienes obsesión por el detalle.** Composición, fotografía, tipografía, color, ritmo… sabes que son los pequeños detalles los que hacen que una pieza pase de correcta a memorable.
* **Piensas en movimiento desde el principio.** No diseñas primero una pieza gráfica para convertirla después en vídeo: piensas en imagen, cámara, ritmo y narrativa desde el minuto uno.
* **Entiendes el lenguaje de cada plataforma.** Sabes que lo que funciona en TikTok no necesariamente funciona en Instagram o YouTube, y adaptas la idea sin perder su esencia.
* **Te mueves bien entre lo grande y lo rápido.** Puedes trabajar en una producción con todos los recursos o sacar adelante una pieza que tiene que estar publicada mañana.
* **Eres resourceful.** No necesitas una gran producción para hacer algo bueno: sabes sacar partido a un móvil, un equipo pequeño y los recursos que tengas a mano.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades incluso cuando nadie te ha dado todavía un brief.

### **¿Qué harás?**

* **Convertir ideas en contenido.** Conceptualizar y desarrollar ideas visuales y audiovisuales para campañas, contenido always\-on y oportunidades culturales en social.
* **Marcar la dirección visual.** Definir el look \& feel de contenidos y activaciones, construyendo una identidad reconocible sin caer en fórmulas o plantillas repetitivas.
* **Dar forma a las ideas.** Crear tratamientos visuales, referencias, moodboards, storyboards y planteamientos de realización que hagan que una idea cobre vida antes de llegar a producción.
* **Grabar y producir.** Coger una cámara o un smartphone y sacar adelante una pieza de principio a fin, adaptando los recursos a lo que necesita cada idea.
* **Resolver en modo social\-first.** Desde entrevistas y producto hasta creators, coberturas, contenido reactivo y formatos que necesitan salir rápido. Sabes moverte con soltura cuando el contexto cambia.
* **Editar y llevar las piezas hasta el final.** Montaje, ritmo, grafismo, motion, sonido y color, cuidando tanto el conjunto como cada detalle.
* **Pensar en cada plataforma.** Adaptar conceptos y piezas para TikTok, Reels, Stories, Shorts, YouTube, LinkedIn y otros formatos digitales, entendiendo qué funciona en cada entorno.
* **Trabajar pegado al equipo de contenido.** Colaborar con Content Manager y Social Intelligence para convertir tendencias, insights y oportunidades editoriales en ideas visuales que merezca la pena producir.
* **Experimentar con IA.** Incorporar herramientas generativas en tu proceso de ideación, preproducción y exploración visual, trabajando junto al AI Content Producer cuando la pieza requiera workflows más complejos.
* **Sacar lo mejor de los creators.** Dirigir a personas delante de cámara de forma natural, ágil y sin convertir cada grabación en un rodaje de película.
* **Defender tus ideas.** Presentar y argumentar conceptos y decisiones visuales ante equipos internos y clientes, sabiendo explicar no solo qué propones, sino por qué funciona.

### **Lo que tienes que dominar**

* **Portfolio con criterio.** Experiencia demostrable en creatividad social y audiovisual, con piezas que demuestren tanto buen ojo como capacidad de ejecución.
* **Cámara y móvil.** Capacidad profesional para grabar con cámara y smartphone, sabiendo elegir el equipo y el enfoque según lo que necesite cada pieza.
* **Lenguaje audiovisual.** Conocimientos sólidos de fotografía, composición, iluminación, encuadre, movimiento y narrativa audiovisual.
* **Herramientas de creación.** Dominio de Adobe Creative Cloud —Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere y After Effects— y soltura con herramientas ágiles como CapCut.
* **Código social.** Conocimiento profundo de formatos, duraciones, hooks, ritmo y códigos visuales y narrativos de TikTok, Instagram/Reels y YouTube/Shorts.
* **IA aplicada a la creatividad.** Familiaridad con herramientas de IA generativa y criterio para incorporarlas en la ideación, preproducción y producción audiovisual cuando realmente aporten valor.

**Cómo trabajas**
-----------------

* **Piensas y haces a la vez.** Te gusta conceptualizar, pero también coger la cámara, probar, grabar y resolver. No eres de los que se quedan en la idea.
* **Sabes que manda la plataforma.** Entiendes sus códigos, su ritmo y lo que hace que una pieza funcione en cada canal. No haces “un vídeo y luego lo adaptas”: piensas nativamente para cada plataforma.
* **Encuentras el equilibrio.** Sabes mantener la identidad de marca sin perder relevancia cultural ni convertir cada contenido en una pieza demasiado corporativa.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades sin esperar a que llegue un brief perfectamente cerrado.

**¿Te gustaría crecer con nosotros/as?**
----------------------------------------


Si buscas un entorno donde la creatividad, la comunicación y la estrategia se unen para generar un impacto real en el negocio, esta puede ser tu oportunidad.


En esta ocasión, te incorporarás a **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, donde formarás parte de un equipo que está redefiniendo la forma en la que las marcas conectan con sus audiencias a través del contenido en plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts.


Si te apasionan los retos, la innovación y el entorno digital, ¡queremos conocerte!


En línea con nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión, animamos a todas las personas a presentar su candidatura, especialmente a quienes forman parte de colectivos tradicionalmente infrarrepresentados, como las personas LGTBIQ\+ o las personas con discapacidad.

**Own the design function for a $1Billion\+ brand. Transform how we build with AI.**

 from here is VP Design → Chief Design Officer. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1\-2 years here for high performers.

 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Head of Design to turn our end\-to\-end web design from a sequential production queue into a fast, AI\-native operation. You will build on our existing AI adoption by establishing consistent workflows, prompt infrastructure, quality controls and system governance that let high\-quality design work ship at volume without extending timelines. While you own the visual and structural execution of the site, you will partner closely with the CRO team, which owns experimentation, including test hypotheses and the conversion roadmap.
 



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce:** 
 very few Heads of Design get simultaneous ownership over the design system, the AI toolchain, the design roadmap and accessibility standards while leading a team of three as a hands\-on player coach and reporting directly to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion. This is not a role where you just review other people's mockups and forward them to engineering. Instead, you are building the operating system for the entire design function.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 rebuild the design workflow from sequential to agile, with kickoff huddles and a 40% reduction in time from design concept to development handoff. Build the prompt library and review workflow covering product copy, FAQs, size/fit guidance, policy explainers, and localized variants. Design the UI patterns for conversational search, guided finders, and PDP Q\&A alongside engineering. Own the recommendation surfaces — placements, card density, "why this" microcopy — and validate them with staged rollouts. Evolve the design system so tokens and components absorb AI\-generated variants without brand drift or PageSpeed cost. Bake WCAG 2\.2 into the system and pair AI\-assisted audits with manual review. Feed the experimentation roadmap with design variants that the CRO team can test at pace, and turn winning patterns into reusable standards across the design system. Shape the future of design at Puffy, where the site is the entire storefront and every conversion point runs through your team.



  





**What Is In It For You** 




 This isn't just another design management role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Design Function and the Toolchain It Runs On** 




 You set the standard, build the workflow, and own what ships.
 


* You design the operating model for the whole function: how work enters the queue, how AI\-generated variants get validated, where human QA sits, and how a spec reaches Dev Mode without losing intent. You own IA, wireframes, high\-fidelity comps, prototypes, and motion specs across Home, PLP, PDP, Cart/Checkout, editorial, and paid\-media landing pages. You decide what the design system tolerates and what it rejects.
* You hold the line on WCAG 2\.2, PageSpeed, and brand consistency while the volume goes up. You’re accountable for design quality, delivery speed, and the design team's contribution to conversion lift. You report to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion, present quarterly design roadmap reviews and translate design decisions \& experiment results into a narrative that the business acts on.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 




 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
 



 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
 



 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space or our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Design Leader Other Brands Come Looking For** 




 In most companies, design leaders inherit a workflow somebody else built and spend their tenure defending its timelines in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides what ships next quarter, your design roadmap is the input to that decision, not a status report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an AI\-native design operation you designed end to end — and the handoff\-time and conversion numbers proving quality held while volume went up, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than a versioning queue in front of you.

**Can you give one of gaming's longest\-running worlds a clear visual voice—and lead the team shaping its next era?**
 RuneScape has welcomed more than 300 million player accounts across 25 years. As the game progresses along its
 **Road to Restoration** 
 , we're looking for an Art Director to define and champion the visual direction behind its next chapter.
   

  

 You'll take ownership of RuneScape's artistic vision across environments, characters, creatures, UI, VFX, lighting and cinematics, bringing greater quality, consistency and clarity to the experience across PC and mobile. You'll lead a large multidisciplinary art team, setting a clear creative direction while staying close to the day\-to\-day realities of live game development.
   

  

 You'll have genuine autonomy to assess how the team operates, evolve its structure and raise the quality bar across the game. Your work will directly influence player experience, the desirability of cosmetic content and the long\-term visual strategy of one of the world's most established MMORPGs.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
* Own and evolve RuneScape's visual direction, creating a cohesive artistic vision across environments, characters, creatures, UI, VFX, lighting and cinematics while respecting the game's established identity.
* Lead and develop a large multidisciplinary art team, assessing its structure, capabilities and craft standards to ensure it is set up to deliver at the required quality and pace.
* Establish and maintain a clear quality bar, reviewing work throughout development and providing actionable direction that improves visual consistency and in\-game execution.
* Drive end\-to\-end improvements to RuneScape's cosmetic content, increasing its quality, consistency and player\-perceived value while supporting an important commercial area of the game.
* Partner with the Creative, Development and Product Directors, aligning artistic priorities with gameplay goals, production requirements and the wider Road to Restoration.
* Work closely with Technical Art and Engineering, improving pipelines, tools and workflows while balancing creative ambition with the technical realities of a live game across PC and mobile.
* Champion accessibility, readability and player experience, ensuring visual decisions support clear gameplay and remain effective across platforms.
* Represent the art discipline across RuneScape and the wider studio, contributing to recruitment, talent development and the game's long\-term creative strategy.


**What we're looking for:**
* Significant, demonstrable experience in Art Direction or senior art leadership within the games industry, gained on shipped or live titles.
* A proven track record of taking artistic direction from initial vision through to in\-game execution, balancing creative ambition with live\-service schedules, technical limitations and production realities.

 If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you're invited to interview.

This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025, representing a major step in building a multi\-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player\-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape's history. For more information, visit https://www.jagex.com/ .
   

  

 Headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom, we are home to passionate creators, storytellers, engineers, and even a few dreamers, all united by a single mission to shape the future of online worlds and empower players to make them their own. We're looking for people to join us who share our ambitions and values. We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences that inspire our communities.

We Hone our Craft by always learning and improving; We Honour our Vows by being honest and transparent; We are our Customers' Heroes by striving to understand our team \& player needs, and We Seize The Day by making the most of every opportunity.
   

  

 Join us. The next era of RuneScape and the next chapter of Jagex: The RuneScape Company starts now.

description:
**About Engine**
 Engine is the all\-in\-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K\+ businesses and groups representing 1\.8M\+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest\-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI\-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.
   

  

 That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025\), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026\), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026\).
   

  

 We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high\-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
   

  

 Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
   

  

**Your Mission**
 Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in\-product moments, and beyond.
   

  

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
   

  

 This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
 **build as much as they lead** 
 shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* **The AI\-assisted creative engine.** 
 Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.** 
 Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open\-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.** 
 Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high\-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.** 
 Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In\-person and experiential creative.** 
 Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.

 Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.

 Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.

 Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

 Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test\-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in\-person moments.
   

  

 Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance\-driven digital work.
* Hands\-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct\-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems\-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast\-moving, AI\-forward environment.

 1\.3 The Creative Director ensures that EVA’s creative output reflects a luxury positioning that is innovative, disciplined, commercially viable, and execution\-ready, while continuously evolving to remain relevant and distinctive in the market.
 



  





**2\.1 Creative Vision, Guidelines \& Governance** 



* The Creative Director defines, documents, and continuously refines EVA Interiors’ creative philosophy and design language, ensuring that spatial principles, material hierarchy, detailing standards, colour strategies, and FF\&E integration are formalised within approved governance frameworks.
* The role ensures that all creative outputs demonstrably comply with documented standards, and that any deviation is formally identified, evaluated, and addressed through structured corrective governance mechanisms rather than informal tolerance.
* The Creative Director maintains executive oversight of all design\-related SOPs to ensure sustained alignment between creative integrity, structured workflows, and disciplined project execution.
* Creative standards shall be applied consistently across all projects and shall be subject to continuous refinement informed by documented review outcomes, performance analysis, and institutional learning.



**2\.2 Measurable Creative Output \& First Time\-Right Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative leadership translates into measurable, predictable, and disciplined quality outcomes.
* A minimum first\-submission approval rate of (80%) shall be maintained across formal design reviews, unless deviations are supported by documented root cause analysis and clearly defined corrective action plans.
* Review cycles shall remain within agreed revision thresholds. Recurrent rework patterns shall trigger structured evaluation, accountability review, and systemic improvement measures rather than normalization.
* All scheduled creative reviews constitute mandatory leadership obligations. Attendance shall be maintained consistently. In cases of unavoidable absence, formal delegation of documented decision authority shall be established in advance. Any missed review shall require written explanation and rescheduling within (24\) hours.
* Approvals, rejections, and required design modifications shall be communicated within agreed review timelines to prevent avoidable production delays or adverse impact on project revenue realization, forecast integrity, or client confidence.
* Review feedback and formal approval decisions shall be issued within (24\) hours of the review session unless otherwise formally justified in writing.
* Creative authority within EVA shall operate as a performance accelerator and governance safeguard, never as a constraint on disciplined production.



**2\.3 Structured Review Cadence \& Institutional Discipline** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for maintaining a defined, documented, and consistently executed creative governance rhythm across the organization.
* At minimum, one structured Creative Review session shall be led weekly, and one formal Quality Retrospective shall be conducted monthly. Each session shall produce documented minutes, clearly assigned accountability, and tracked follow\-up actions.
* Recurring quality deviations, review inefficiencies, or creative inconsistencies shall be translated into updated guidelines, strengthened enforcement protocols, or revised governance standards.
* Creative governance within EVA shall be cyclical, documented, and continuously reinforced to ensure institutional maturity and sustained quality performance.



**2\.4 Commercial Alignment \& Revenue Protection** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative decisions are aligned with approved project timelines, revenue realization schedules, forecast commitments, and overall project profitability.
* The Creative Director shall collaborate with Planning and Operations to ensure that creative timelines and review cycles are realistically reflected in revenue forecasts, milestone commitments, and execution sequencing.
* Creative refinement shall not introduce avoidable delays that negatively affect revenue progression, cash flow timing, forecast accuracy, or client confidence.
* Where creative ambition presents potential timeline, cost, or commercial exposure, such implications shall be proactively identified, formally evaluated, and resolved in coordination with project leadership and Executive Management.
* Design excellence within EVA is expected to unlock commercial value while preserving disciplined control over schedule, cost, and revenue integrity.



**2\.5 Escalation \& Risk Management Obligation** 



* Any creative, quality, review\-related, or design governance issue that may materially impact project timelines, revenue realization, client confidence, or brand reputation shall be escalated to Executive Management within (24\) hours.
* Escalation shall include a documented impact assessment, root cause analysis, and proposed mitigation strategy.
* No material creative risk shall remain unaddressed, undocumented, or without executive visibility.



**2\.6 Enforcement Authority \& Team Performance Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for enforcing compliance with approved design standards, governance frameworks, and review discipline across all design personnel.
* Where repeated non\-compliance, quality deviation, review absence, or execution inconsistency occurs, the Creative Director shall initiate structured corrective action in coordination with Executive Management and Human Resources.
* Delegation of responsibilities does not eliminate accountability for creative outcomes. Enforcement authority is inherent to the role and integral to its seniority, Sustained failure to meet defined governance cadence, revision thresholds, escalation timelines, or documented enforcement obligations shall constitute performance non\-compliance and shall be subject to formal performance review in accordance with company policy.



**2\.7 Innovation \& Strategic Creative Development** 



* The Creative Director leads structured innovation initiatives designed to enhance differentiation, strengthen quality standards, and improve execution efficiency.
* Innovation must be practical, buildable, commercially responsible, and clearly linked to brand positioning or project value.
* Creative experimentation must be governed, documented, and selectively integrated into live projects where appropriate.



**2\.8 FF\&E Library Governance \& Design Asset Control** 



* The Creative Director holds strategic ownership of EVA’s FF\&E Library and ensures that it remains curated, quality\-controlled, commercially viable, and aligned with EVA’s luxury positioning.
* All additions shall meet defined standards of originality, feasibility, execution readiness, and brand coherence.
* The FF\&E Library shall function as an active production, quality\-control, and creative governance asset supporting consistency and efficiency across projects.



**2\.9 Leadership Presence \& Accessibility** 



* The Creative Director is expected to maintain consistent on\-site leadership presence during critical review cycles, high\-visibility project phases, and production\-intensive periods.
* Leadership availability and accessibility are structural expectations of the role. Remote work arrangements shall not compromise review cadence, enforcement discipline, team accessibility, or executive responsiveness and require formal approval in accordance with company policy.
* Creative leadership within EVA requires visible authority, sustained engagement, and operational presence commensurate with the seniority of the role.

**Art Director (Strategic \& Client\-Facing)**


**Sircle Media**



Sircle Media is a social\-first creative agency based in New York City, partnering with leading brands across CPG \& Beverage. We specialize in strategy, content creation, and paid media, helping brands win both online and in\-store. Since 2012, we’ve built a reputation as a best\-in\-class partner for brands looking to scale with smart, high\-performing creative.

**The Role**


**Title:** Art Director (Strategic \& Client\-Facing)


**Must\-Haves (non\-negotiable)**


* 4\+ years as an Art Director with **documented, independent ownership** of both the strategic direction and the client relationship for at least one brand. We’re looking for someone who led and owned the work independently, and not shared ownership with others, or only "contributed to".
* You’ve built strategic foundations that guide a brand’s social and content, not just executed against an existing brief.

* **Strong self\-management skills**, you’re able to run your own schedule, prioritize across multiple accounts, and stay on top of deadlines independently in a fully remote environment

title: Creative Director
description:
**The Problem**
 Flock's creative group is expanding as the company raises its standard of visual storytelling and campaign execution across brand, film, and digital experiences. This momentum creates a need for unified creative leadership to turn complex technology and public safety outcomes into compelling, human\-centered narratives. You will own that direction, driving the creative concept, visual identity, and craft bar across design, film, and motion.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Direct integrated campaigns, product launch narratives, and flagship brand films from initial concept through final delivery.
* Define and maintain the visual, cinematic, and editorial standards across design, motion, and video production to build a recognizable creative signature.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary craft teams, guiding discipline leads in art direction, storytelling, and creative critique.
* Establish operational systems, including reference libraries, templates, and production guidelines, that elevate quality while improving delivery speed.
* Partner with brand strategy and production leadership to translate executive goals into clear creative briefs and execution plans.


**What This Role Is Not**
* This is not a hands\-off review role, you will actively shape concepts, guide edits, direct art execution, and refine details across all mediums.
* This isn't a high\-volume template production management job, your main focus is establishing concept quality and narrative depth.
* This is not an isolated brand strategy position, you will work directly alongside production and cross\-functional teams to ship live campaigns.


**What You Bring**
* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary creative teams across art direction, design, motion, and cinematic film production.
* Deep portfolio demonstrating high\-craft visual design alongside narrative documentary or high\-paced commercial storytelling.
* Advanced fluency in the complete production lifecycle, including typography, editing pace, color grading, sound design, and finishing standards.
* Experience setting practical brand guidelines, design systems, and creative review frameworks for internal teams and agency partners.
* Ability to direct campaigns that balance emotional human narrative with clear technical product messaging.


**Compensation**
 In this role, you'll receive a starting salary between $200,000 and $250,000 as well as Flock Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in depth with you during our first chat.
   

  

 Why Flock 💚
   

  

 Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.
   

  

 📍Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub\-based roles mean real in\-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.
   

  

 🌟 The impossible takes every kind of mind. Flock is an equal opportunity employer, and we know the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills working together with mutual respect. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.
   

  

 💰 On compensation. We pay fairly for the work. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education, training, and market indicators. The range in this posting covers base salary only and doesn't include equity, sales bonus plans where applicable, or benefits. The range may be adjusted over time, and this posting may span more than one career level.
   

  

 📣 One last thing. All legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. We never make offers through messaging apps or third parties, and we never request payment or sensitive personal information during hiring. If you encounter suspicious outreach about a Flock role, report it to recruiting@flocksafety.com.

title: Director, Brand Strategy and Marketing
description:
The Director, Brand Strategy and Marketing is a key leader in the marketing and communications department who develops, implements, and evaluates integrated brand initiatives and marketing plans in support of University of Iowa Health Care’s strategies with the direction of the Chief Marketing and Communications Officer. The director leads the marketing team, including clinical services marketing, growth initiatives, community and business partnerships, and special projects. The director identifies opportunities that support our patient care and medical and research mission as the state’s only comprehensive academic medical center.
   

  

 The director represents the voice of the customer to inform business, marketing, and brand strategy. They collaborate and work effectively and efficiently across the marketing and communications department – as well as the health system \- to build the UI Health brand and implement priority marketing initiatives.
   

  

 This position is eligible for
 **hybrid** 
 work within Iowa and will require a work arrangement form to be completed upon the start of your employment. Per policy, work arrangements will be reviewed annually and must comply with the remote work program and related policies and employee travel policy when working at a remote location.
   

  

**This position is not eligible for University sponsorship for employment authorization now or in the future.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Research and Analysis**
* Identify and direct market/audience research and competitive analysis to inform organizational strategy. Incorporate insights into the marketing plans.
* Identify and maximize marketing technology, including customer relationship management (CRM) system.
* Advance return\-on\-investment analysis to support strategic decision making on where to invest resources and measure the effectiveness of initiatives.


**Marketing Plan**
* Oversee the creation, development, and implementation of integrated brand and marketing strategy, plans, campaigns, and messaging for identified programs and services.
* Translate organizational strategy into marketing plans for service lines, community and business partnerships, and growth initiatives.
* Assess service line market readiness.
* Create consistent standards of service across clients and teams.


**Brand Management**
* Oversee brand positioning and execution, including advertising, that aligns with market/audience research and the organization’s goals.
* Support growth and development of University of Iowa Health Care’s brand.
* Promote consistent brand use and set brand guidelines and governance.


**Project Management**
* Direct the portfolio of large\-scale, complex marketing projects and initiatives.
* Establish priorities, timelines, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Collaborate with other Marketing and Communication directors on shared goals for growth, reputation, and engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Example: website and digital channel content.
* Oversee external agency assignments and performance as extensions of the internal team.
* Resolve project risk, conflicts, and capacity challenges.


**Financial Responsibility**
* Develop, manage, and evaluate the marketing division budget
* Approve marketing expenses and contracts.
* Define expected outcomes tied to growth and engagement.


**Supervision/Leadership**
* Lead, engage, and develop a team of directors, managers, and others within the marketing division to achieve shared, set goals.
* Contribute to workforce planning and talent development strategies.
* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, physicians, and health system teams to provide strategic counsel and leadership.
* Promote a high\-performance, data\-informed marketing culture.
* Serve on committees, boards, and other groups representing UI Health Care and the Marketing and Communications department, as requested.
* Follow the department’s vision, standards, and policies.


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
* 5\-7 years of experience in progressive brand strategy that may include brand management and integration, creative development, and digital marketing strategy
* Tactical expertise and experience in marketing planning, strategic marketing analysis, advertising development, implementation, and measurement
* Excellent oral, written, and presentation skills
* Ability to build positive client relationships and provide excellent service
* Strong management, analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills
* Proven project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines
* Collaborative approach
* Ability to guide professional staff and anticipate and resolve conflict
* Proficiency in MS Office
* Valid driver’s license plus the ability to meet the University of Iowa Fleet Safety program driving standards.
* Demonstrated experience working effectively in a welcoming and respectful workplace environment.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Three years of experience in health care marketing in an academic medical center or multi\-hospital system
* High degree of creativity, self\-motivation, and initiative
* Experience with Jira project management system
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate ideas and findings to senior leadership
* Knowledge of University of Iowa and UI Health Care policies and procedures

title: HR Director
description:
Eterniti is the leading operator of vacation rentals in iconic holiday destinations, led by a passion for excellence, authentic adventures, and hospitality. With over €2 billion in assets under management, we operate 800\+ chalets, villas and apartments under 3 consumer brands: Emerald Stay (our 4\* brand), Bo House (our 5\* brand) and Verbier Exclusive (our Palace brand). Our guests can discover our properties in more than 25 exceptional destinations across Europe and North America. We are a fast\-growing company generating around €100M in annual revenue, backed by more than €50M raised from top\-tier investors. Join us at a pivotal moment, with the ambition and the means to keep raising the bar.  

  

We are looking for a talented **part\-time People Director (50\-60%)** to join our dynamic team, at our Barcelona office. In this role, you will be exposed to an international group spanning various business units, where your ability to protect and nurture our culture and to excel at recruitment will be absolutely key to your success.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**  

  

**Strategic HR \& business partnering**

* Act as HR Business Partner for all companies in the group.
* Ensure HR monitoring and compliance.
* Be accountable for the OKRs process, together with our Chief of Staff.
* Run the annual employee survey and propose an annual HR plan based on the results.
* Own, monitor and act on the people dashboards to steer performance across destinations.

**Culture, communication \& engagement**

* Be the guardian of our group's culture.
* Lead HR and internal communication projects (internal newsletters, AI trainings, Learning \& Development, etc.).

* Oversee recruitment and training.
* Participate in team members' onboardings and offboardings.

**Team management, entities \& tools**

* Manage two HR team members.
* Complete the HR integration with the Jewels (acquired companies).
* Handle key individual HR matters and HR situations that escalate.
* Be accountable for our HR tools: JazzHR and Skello.


Depending on priorities as well as your bandwidth, skills and interest, you may be involved in other projects, in line with your qualifications.

 **KEY INFORMATION**

* Employment start: as soon as possible.
* Reporting to the CEO (Maxime Friess) and COO (Laurent Lacourt).

	+ Step 1: screening call for selected candidates.

	+ Step 3: video interview with our Chief People Officer and our HR Manager.
	+ Step 4: video interview with our COO.
	+ Step 5: video interview with our CEO.
	+ Step 6: references check.

**We’d love to hear from you if…**

* You have solid senior HR / People experience, ideally across several entities or countries: at least 5 years.
* You are an entrepreneur at heart and have prior experience at a fast\-growing startup \- we expect you to be proactive and constructive at all times; you thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* You combine strategic HR business partnering with a hands\-on, get\-things\-done approach.
* You are a natural people leader who builds trust and handles confidential matters with discretion.
* You have a good working knowledge of labour and employment frameworks (France and Spain a plus).
* You are comfortable steering with data, dashboards and KPIs, and strong with digital tools.
* You speak (and write) French and English fluently; Spanish is a plus.
* You can work in the EU without visa sponsorship.

**ABOUT US**


We offer a work environment that values and empowers people while fostering personal development. Our culture is dictated by the following values :

* **Make Mistakes** \- We foster a creative environment where the best ideas win, where it is okay to make mistakes and unacceptable not to learn from them.
* **Question** \- We don't accept the status quo and look for ways to leverage technology while empowering people.
* **Speak Up** \- We are true people who give honest feedback, who are not afraid to share opinions and who don't talk behind one's back.
* **Think Big** \- While staying humble, we aim for the stars and work towards established goals and metrics.
* **Don’t Compromise** \- We are obsessed with quality, like a Swiss watchmaker.
* **Care** \- We care about our team members, our partners and our clients, and make our passion and our work one and the same.


We are demanding \- everyone really counts at Eterniti. But keep in mind that we value hard work and give growth opportunities to those who deserve it. We want you to grow with the company.  

  

*We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to any characteristic unrelated to their skills and experience.*

**Oh, we’ve got perks...**

* **Flexible work environment**: we have a flexible home office policy; you'll work at the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, the rest of the time, it's up to you. Feeling like working with another view? We offer 15 days yearly of remote work from wherever you’d like
* **Flexible benefits**: you’ll get a card to spend on what matters most to you: food, transport, or health insurance to optimize your net income
* **Discount on Emerald stays**, during specific periods, on selected properties
* **Regular team outings and events**: because work is fun when you’re part of an awesome team
* **External coaching**: for supervisor level and above \- we believe and invest in you
* **Anniversary perks**

 **Ready to join?**

### **If you're willing to bring your creativity, passion for service, and high\-energy vibe to Eterniti, we want to hear from you. Apply today and let's start this exciting journey together!**

Hospital Sant Joan de Déu Barcelona (HSJD) is a private non\-profit institution with a vocation for public service since its creation in 1867\. Our hospital is dedicated to the comprehensive care of women, children and adolescents and has become one of the most important specialised centres in Europe in Paediatrics and Obstetrics, and a reference centre in healthcare, teaching and research.  

  

Our care is based on the multidisciplinary work of our professionals and is characterised by a high level of specialisation which integrates cutting\-edge technology, not only to improve the health of our patients and the community, but also to advance scientific knowledge. Through the Sant Joan de Déu Research Institute (IRSJD) and its Research Foundation (FSJD), we conduct research to find new and better treatments for maternal and foetal diseases, children and young adults’ health problems and mental health conditions. As a University of Barcelona affiliated hospital, we contribute to the training of health professionals at different stages, from undergraduate to master’s and doctoral degrees.  

  

Within HSJD, the Directorate of Research, Innovation and Learning (DRIL) manages and coordinates the activities of the hospital related to the definition of the strategic agenda of its three areas of influence, overseeing the design, promotion and implementation of strategic institutional projects within them. Additionally, the Director of DRIL is also the Scientific Director of the IRSJD.  

  

We, at the Directorate of Research, Innovation and Learning, have an innovative approach to management and are seeking a talented and motivated Project Manager to provide high\-level support to the DRIL leadership team in the implementation of our strategic agenda related specifically to Advanced Therapies and Internationalisation.

title: Head of Research & Editorial
description:
**About Platform Engineering**
------------------------------


Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through **PlatformCon**, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision\-makers every year to share ideas, showcase innovation, and shape the future of internal developer platforms.


Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, a growing YouTube channel, and **Weave Intelligence**, our research arm: the analyst practice behind the State of Platform Engineering report, market guides on the platform engineering reference architecture, and a growing set of data products on how the agentic enterprise is actually being built.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Head of Research \& Editorial** to lead Weave Intelligence and own what we say about the industry.


This is the role that owns Platform Engineering's intellectual agenda. Everything we publish across every channel starts with a thesis about where platform engineering, internal developer platforms and agentic software development are going. Today that thesis lives in the heads of our founders. You will make it a practice: a research agenda, an editorial calendar, a standard for what counts as evidence, and a team that turns it into reports, guides, articles, courses and video that the market reads first.


You'll be a named analyst, not a manager of analysts. You will publish under your own byline, take briefings from vendors, sit on our analyst desk at PlatformCon and at KubeCon, re:Invent and Google Cloud Next, and represent Weave in the press. We want you to become one of the voices the industry associates with platform engineering.


You'll also lead the content team that already exists and works: a content operations lead who runs the engine and manages our designers, a narratives and quality lead who holds the bar on every piece, and a video producer who is building our channel. The production engine already exists. Your job is to decide where it points, raise the intellectual and editorial bar, and spend meaningful time doing the research and writing yourself

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the house thesis on platform engineering, PE\+\+ and the agentic enterprise, and keep it ahead of the market.
* Run a quarterly theme calendar that every report, article, webinar, course and video hangs off, and make sure content, events and sales are telling the same story.
* Set the split between net\-new thought leadership backed by our own data and rapid\-response analysis of what the market is discussing, and decide which topics deserve which.
* Lead the Weave Intelligence analyst practice: research agenda, methodology standards, editorial ownership of the State of Platform Engineering and State of AI \& Platform Engineering reports, market guides, and the vendor briefings program.
* Apply and defend our firewall: sponsors buy distribution and association, never conclusions; methodology is published before results; sponsored and syndicated work is always labeled.
* Publish regularly under your own name, and take the analyst chair at our events and at the industry majors we attend.
* Take vendor and enterprise briefings, and turn them into a structured view of the vendor landscape that feeds our reference architecture and our research.
* Lead and develop the content team: a content PM, a narratives and QA lead, a video producer, and through them our brand designers.
* Build relationships with other media houses, analyst firms and independent voices for co\-published research, syndication and joint formats.
* Work with our founders on their public positioning, so that the strongest ideas in the company reach the stage and the page.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 6\+ years in roles where your job was to understand a technology market and say something about it that held up: industry analyst, editor or lead writer at a technical publication, content or product marketing lead who shaped a category, or developer advocacy lead with a strategic remit.
* Real depth in platform engineering, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or the adoption of AI in software development. You can hold your own with a staff engineer and a CTO in the same conversation.
* A body of published work under your own name, and a view on where the industry is going that you can defend with evidence.
* Narrative judgment: you know the difference between a topic and a thesis, and between something that is true and something that is worth saying now.
* Editorial rigor. You have run methodology, sourcing and fact\-checking on work where being wrong had consequences.
* Experience leading a small team of writers, researchers or producers, and making them better rather than louder.
* Comfort in public: on stage, on camera, in a briefing room with a vendor's leadership team.
* Operating discipline: calendars, standards and a cadence that ships.
* Exceptional written and spoken English
* Willingness to travel a few times per year for events and offsites.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience inside an analyst firm, or on the receiving end of one as a vendor.
* A track record of building something recognized as a source: a report people cite, a newsletter people forward, a format people copy.
* Familiarity with survey design and quantitative research methods.
* Existing relationships across the cloud native and developer tooling ecosystem.
* Hands\-on engineering or platform background earlier in your career.
* A practical view on where AI helps and hurts research and editorial work.
* Experience working in a startup or scale\-up, and with remote, globally distributed teams.

**Why join us?**
----------------


Most analyst jobs ask you to describe a market someone else built. This one asks you to shape one. Platform engineering is a discipline that our community defined, and the agentic enterprise is being defined right now. You'd be doing that work with direct access to the people building the world's most interesting internal developer platforms, a community of hundreds of thousands who already trust us, and a team that can turn an idea into a report, a course, a stage talk and a video in weeks.


There is no legacy research franchise to protect and no house style to inherit. If you want a role where your judgment about what matters becomes what the industry reads, this is that role.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead the identification and articulation of MGID’s overall strategy and strategic direction for the next 3–5 years, aligning with business focus and growth trajectory.
* Evaluate strategic perspectives for specific products and portfolios, assessing market exposure, competitive dynamics, and growth potential.
* Support the shift from a product\-led to a customer\-value\-led company by embedding customer\-centric frameworks into strategic planning, prioritization, and roadmap decisions.

**Responsibilities**

**Job ID** R\-259586 **Date posted** 09/07/2026
“It is critical that we build and maintain our rich tradition of clinical expertise in support of developing life\-changing medicines for patients.” –Jose Baselga


The Baselga Cancer Research Scholars Program, initiated in 2020, is a 2\-year immersive education and research program for early\-career Oncologists who are inspired by science and by how clinical development has the potential to transform patient care. As part of a competitively selected cohort of Scholars, you will join an accelerated development track within Oncology R\&D. Selected Scholars will join the current cohort of Baselga Cancer Research Scholars, building a vibrant community of drug developers. We are currently recruiting for the 2027 class with an aim to start the position in summer\-autumn 2027\.


**About AstraZeneca Oncology Research \& Development**


Our Oncology strategy is built with one goal in mind – pushing the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. We have a passion for discovery and a broad pipeline of next\-generation medicines, and together with a focus on execution excellence, we aim to expand treatment options and improve outcomes for patients with solid and haematological cancers. We’re pioneering innovative research across six scientific platforms: Tumor drivers and resistance; Immuno\-oncology, DNA damage response, Antibody drug conjugates, Epigenetics and Cell therapies.


Our ambition is to eliminate cancer as a cause of death. It’s our big vision that unites and inspires us. With multiple indications and high\-quality molecules at all stages of our innovative pipeline, we keep pushing forward. Focusing on cutting\-edge science with the latest technology to achieve breakthroughs. AZ is a place built on courage, curiosity and collaboration – we make bold decisions driven by patient outcomes.

The 2027 AZ Baselga Cancer Research Scholars cohort will join AstraZeneca at a time of tremendous growth and acceleration in the oncology biologics portfolio. Working in a fast\-paced and dynamic work environment you will experience increasing levels of responsibility, following a structured learning plan in the following domains:


1\) **Clinical Study Assignment:** You will join a clinical study team and build experience as a medical leader in clinical development which could be in Early Clinical Development, Late Clinical Development, or one year in each. You will participate in weekly clinical and scientific meetings related to your clinical study, complete AstraZeneca training programs and participate in internal and external scientific meetings. You will work in a cross functional environment, contributing to and supporting Department/Clinical initiatives to improve the quality and content of all clinical programs as well as the cross functional/organization processes designed to effectively deliver our R\&D portfolio.


Specific duties and major responsibilities for the longitudinal medical project may include any of the following:


* Serving as medical director with primary responsibility for patient safety and conduct of assigned trials as well as overall data interpretation and safety surveillance
* Establishing and approving scientific methods for design and implementation of applicable clinical protocols, data collection systems, and final reports
* Assisting in design of clinical development plans and overall strategy for compounds, therapeutic classes of compounds or indications in light of developments in the area of clinical and pharmaceutical oncology
* Collaborating with pre\-clinical and translational sciences, and senior management in assessing requirements for emerging products
* Participating in the selection and management activities of CROs
* Supervising project team members in planning, conducting and evaluating clinical trials
* Planning and managing investigator meetings, advisory boards and other scientific committees

2\) **Rotational program:** During the course of your program, you will be involved in 3\-6 month long rotations across various groups to gain a better understanding of the cross\-functional departments. This could include:


* Patient safety
* Clinical operations
* Regulatory affairs
* Biostatistics
* Medical affairs
* Translational medicine or precision medicine

3\) **Longitudinal Research Project:** You will have opportunity to lead an innovative research project of your choosing for the duration of the 2\-year program, which may be an area of special interest to you and AstraZeneca, or alternatively focus on one or more of the rotational functions. You will be able to harness rich internal datasets and expertise, aiming to deliver a research project at the end of the Program which will be presented to key internal stakeholders, at a key scientific meeting and published in a peer\-reviewed journal.

MD or equivalent required; ideally board certified (or eligible) preferred in Oncology or Haematology/Oncology

* Experience in molecular oncology and/or translational science
* Medical specialty and sub\-specialty training and Board Certification

* Proven leadership skills and demonstrated ability to interact collaboratively in a cross\-functional environment.

We're not looking for someone to just execute a checklist. This role needs a creative problem\-solver who writes well, thinks ahead, and brings ideas for how to do things better, not just someone who completes tasks as assigned. You'll have ownership over how programs get built and communicated, and we want someone who's enthusiastic and curious about using AI to work smarter, whether that's research, dashboards, or automating the repetitive parts of the job.


This is a foundational role on a growing team. Graphite runs L\&D through as a single person team now, and this hire is what lets it scale. You'll start focused on execution: building onboarding materials, tracking program data, and keeping our internal L\&D channel active.


Within your first year, you'll take on more content creation, community\-building, and program facilitation as you learn the business and our programs.

* A clear, engaging writer who can make training content feel practical \& exciting.
* Organized and proactive by nature, you flag problems before they become blockers.
* Genuinely curious, you like figuring out a better way to do something rather than just doing it the way you've always done it.

* Post regular updates to our L\&D Slack channel: session recaps, upcoming sessions, and useful resources for the team.
* Support our intern and shadowing programs with onboarding, tracking, and kickoff logistics.
* Help maintain compliance training materials, including templates for subject\-matter experts and completion tracking.
* As you grow in the role, take on drafting original training content (modules, decks, videos) and help build out a more consistent L\&D content and community presence company\-wide.

**Required experience**

* 1\-2 years of experience in training coordination, HR, learning operations, or a related role.
* Strong writing skills, with a portfolio or writing sample that shows range.
* Comfortable working in a Learning Management System (we use Disco) or similar platform.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools for research, reporting, or workflow automation, this isn't just familiarity, we want to see how you've actually used them.
* Excellent organizational skills, with close attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.
* Genuine interest in learning and development as a career path.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with content creation: writing, video, or presentation design.
* Experience with data collection and analysis, including building charts and reports on training data.
* Familiarity with growth marketing, SEO, or AEO concepts (or willingness to learn them quickly, since our training content covers this space).
