**About CookUnity**
 Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first\-of\-its\-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready\-to\-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.
   

  

 Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever\-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission:
 **empower Chefs to nourish the world.**
 If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At CookUnity, the Brand Marketing team is responsible for developing and executing world\-class marketing activations and experiences that drive brand awareness and earn loyalty beyond reason. This team sets the vision and strategy for the brand and brings it to life with strategic rigor, creative excellence, and cultural relevance. Through insight\-inspired, data\-informed brand storytelling and experiences, CookUnity’s Brand Marketing team will build a category\-defining brand loved by an entire generation of foodies.
   

  

**The Role**
 CookUnity is seeking a seasoned brand design manager to take our creative function to the next level — elevating design craft, modernizing design operations, and boldly differentiating the CookUnity brand. In this role you will oversee the development and expression of the brand visual identity across all consumer touch points, both online and offline, while managing and actively leveling up a team of talented, ambitious designers.
   

  

 Through your leadership and vision, you will build and scale a world\-class brand design function with customer obsession and creative excellence at its core. The ideal candidate brings not only a mastery of design craft honed at best\-in\-class consumer brands, but also the operational rigor to implement new standards of design process and team performance — and the forward\-thinking mindset to leverage AI tools as a high\-impact lever for quality and efficiency.
   

  

 This is a role for a leader who sets the bar high, builds the systems to meet it, and brings a team along for the journey. Reporting to the VP of Brand Marketing, this role is uniquely positioned to create an impact that helps CookUnity resonate emotionally and grow commercially in unprecedented ways.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Creative Vision \& Brand Stewardship**
* Develop and evangelize an inspiring creative vision for the future of CookUnity and help the organization make progress towards achieving its full potential
* Lead the Brand Design team to bring the essence of CookUnity to life through a differentiated design system and visual storytelling across website, app, social media, advertising, CRM, and a growing ecosystem of packaging
* Own, refine, and continue to build on the CookUnity brand identity and visual system as a living resource that evolves with new learnings and insights to better support the needs of the customer and company
* Bring the standards and instincts of best\-in\-class consumer brands to CookUnity — championing unwavering expectations for design craft, quality, and executional consistency


**Design Process \& Operational Excellence**
* Design and manage an ambitious, end\-to\-end creative process — including intake, internal creative reviews, stakeholder feedback cycles, and approval workflows — that ensures consistently on\-time delivery of high\-quality assets
* Lead regular creative reviews of all ongoing design work to provide timely feedback and coaching, and ensure pixel\-perfect execution across all design deliverables
* Lead the routing, feedback, and approval process for brand design deliverables to executive staff and Founder as needed for high\-visibility, high\-impact initiatives


**AI Integration \& Design Innovation**
* Champion the integration of AI\-based tools into the team's design workflows, identifying high\-impact opportunities to automate repeatable tasks, accelerate production, and free the team to focus on higher\-order creative work
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and serve as an internal resource for best practices, responsible use, and practical application within a brand design context
* Foster a team culture that embraces experimentation with emerging tools while maintaining the quality standards and creative integrity the brand demands


**Team Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Mentor and motivate a small but mighty team of talented designers, actively leveling up individual skills through structured feedback, coaching, and growth\-oriented development conversations
* Build a culture of trust, openness, accountability, and a relentless pursuit of design excellence — where high standards are a shared value, not just a directive
* Lead by doing: maintain mastery of the tools the team uses daily (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Claude Design, and relevant AI design tools) and be willing to roll up your sleeves alongside the team when needed


**Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner with teammates, peers, and key stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities or challenges, and take a leadership role in bringing tangible design solutions forward
* Partner directly with brand copy team to define visual storytelling approach, ensuring consistency and deep integration between these teams to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of all creative output
* Assume a strong company presence as an internal standard\-bearer of category\-defining creativity, building trust, alignment, and influence across the organization
* Bring principles of design thinking, a solution\-oriented mindset, and an entrepreneurial spirit to achieving impactful results without depending on significant resources


**Minimum Requirements**
* 8\+ years experience in brand design; experience in top consumer brands and/or agencies is a plus
* 4\+ years managing other designers
* A respected brand design leader with a track record of shipping excellent work and a portfolio demonstrating a mastery of design craft across multiple disciplines of design
* Proficiency in video and how to leverage design in this format is a plus
* Passion for insights and performance data in shaping creative work and a commitment to building a culture that embraces these essential inputs
* Experience operating in a fast\-paced growth environment, including dealing with ambiguity, shifting priorities \& rapid iteration
* Very detail oriented, well organized, and a proven ability to effectively manage multiple projects, work streams, or initiatives simultaneously
* Highly collaborative in nature with ability to partner across various functions throughout a company and demonstrate flexible decision\-making based on new insight or feedback
* A genuine passion for design and a love of the creative process
* Proficiency in English at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field is a plus


**Learn More About CookUnity**
 We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.
   

  

 We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!
   

  

**Benefits**
 💸 Get paid in USD
   

  

 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.
   

  

 ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date.
   

  

 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.
   

  

 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3\-5 days each time the need arises.
   

  

 🐣 Family leave of 12 weeks for primary caregiver and 6 weeks for secondary caregiver, fully paid.
   

  

 🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.
   

  

 🤖 AI\-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.
   

  

 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you.
 **Thank you for your time!**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.*

We Also Want You To Know That We Take This Seriously — Sometimes, As Part Of Our Process, We May Ask For a Brief “proof Of Humanity” To Confirm That We’re Connecting With a Real Person, Not An Impersonator. title: Growth & Acquisition Marketing Manager
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
The Global Talent Co.
   

  

* Remote
* Full\-time


**About The Opportunity**
 The Global Talent Co. is recruiting on behalf of a fast\-growing DTC wellness brand whose mission is simple: help people live healthier. They're scaling their customer acquisition engine and looking to connect it more tightly to the full customer journey.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Growth \& Acquisition Marketing Manager to own our client's customer acquisition strategy across paid media and emerging growth channels. You'll manage their paid media agency, set acquisition strategy, guide creative testing, oversee media investment, and make sure every paid dollar is directly tied to DTC growth goals.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of the digital growth engine — working closely with the Lifecycle \& Retention Manager, e\-commerce team, creative partners, and agency teams to keep the customer journey connected from first impression to purchase and beyond. You'll own strategy, performance accountability, budget planning, reporting, and the business decisions behind paid acquisition.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strategic operator who understands performance marketing and paid platforms inside and out — analytical, commercially minded, creative, and comfortable pushing back on agency recommendations to make sure media investment is working as hard as possible.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Acquisition Strategy** 
 Own acquisition strategy across paid media and emerging growth channels — Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, affiliate, influencer, retail media, and beyond. Build plans that support product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and always\-on growth, balancing efficiency, growth, and long\-term customer value.
   

  

**Agency Leadership \& Performance Accountability** 
 Own the day\-to\-day relationship with the paid media agency. Hold them accountable to performance targets, reporting quality, and testing velocity. Review plans, challenge assumptions, and translate agency output into clear decisions for the internal team.
   

  

**Budget Management \& Forecasting** 
 Own paid media budget planning, pacing, and investment recommendations. Build monthly and quarterly plans tied to DTC revenue goals, and monitor CAC, MER, ROAS, and new customer acquisition to keep investment sharp.
   

  

**Creative Testing \& Growth Insights** 
 Build a creative testing roadmap with the agency and creative team. Brief creative needs from customer insights and performance data, and share what's working across email, SMS, website, social, and brand marketing.
   

  

**Reporting \& Analytics** 
 Own weekly and monthly reporting on paid acquisition — new customers, revenue, CAC, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, AOV, payback, and channel performance — and turn the data into business recommendations, not just campaign updates.
   

  

**Cross\-Channel Collaboration** 
 Partner with Lifecycle \& Retention, e\-commerce, Creative, Brand, Innovation, CX, and Sales to keep acquisition strategy connected to the rest of the business.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 4\+ years in growth, acquisition, performance, or digital marketing
* Proven experience managing paid media programs, in\-house or through an agency
* Experience managing agency relationships and holding partners accountable
* Strong grasp of customer acquisition, media investment, and channel strategy
* DTC, Shopify, CPG, wellness, beauty, food, or beverage experience strongly preferred
* Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution
* Strong communicator — can present performance insights and recommendations clearly
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience


**Technical Skills**
* Strong command of Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, affiliate, paid social, and paid search
* Fluent in acquisition metrics: CAC, MER, ROAS, new customer revenue, conversion rate, AOV, LTV, payback
* Experience with GA4, Shopify analytics, ad platform reporting, dashboards, UTMs, pixels, and conversion tracking
* Solid budget management and forecasting skills
* Experience building testing frameworks across creative, audience, landing page, and channel mix


**Who You Are**
 Passionate about health and wellness. Driven by growth but disciplined about efficiency and profitability. Commercially minded, analytical, and creative — someone who connects marketing activity to revenue outcomes and isn't afraid to challenge an agency's recommendation. A self\-starter who moves quickly and takes ownership in a high\-growth environment.

title: Senior Couture Pattern Maker & Sample Maker ( freelance )
description:
Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker

We are looking for a freelancer highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker to join our fashion atelier.

The ideal candidate must be able to take a design from concept or sketch through the full garment\-development process, including pattern making, draping, fabric cutting, garment construction, fitting, alterations, and couture\-level finishing.

This role requires someone with strong technical knowledge, excellent craftsmanship, and the ability to work independently on complex womenswear and couture pieces.

Key Responsibilities

\* Interpret fashion sketches, reference images, and creative direction and translate them into technically feasible garments.

\* Create accurate patterns from sketches, measurements, existing garments, or draped toile.

\* Draping directly on the mannequin to develop silhouettes, volume, gathers, pleats, asymmetric shapes, and flowing designs.

\* Prepare toiles and prototypes for fitting and development.

\* Cut fabrics accurately, including delicate and luxury materials such as silk, chiffon, organza, satin, lace, tulle, crepe, and other couture fabrics.

\* Construct complete garments from first sample through final piece.

\* Perform both machine sewing and high\-quality hand sewing.

\* Apply couture finishing techniques, including invisible hems, hand finishing, internal finishing, delicate closures, and clean seam construction.

\* Understand garment structure, balance, fit, proportion, and movement.

\* Conduct fittings and make necessary pattern and garment adjustments.

\* Develop solutions for internal garment support, boning, lining, interfacing, corsetry, and structured areas when required.

\* Work carefully with complex draping, bias\-cut garments, layered fabrics, and intricate silhouettes.

\* Ensure every garment meets a very high standard of craftsmanship, fit, and finishing.

\* Recommend appropriate construction methods based on the design and selected fabric.

\* Minimize fabric waste while maintaining accurate cutting and quality.

\* Maintain organized patterns, samples, and garment\-development records.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director to develop and refine each design while maintaining the original creative vision.

Required Experience \& Skills

\* Strong professional experience in couture, bridal, eveningwear, luxury womenswear, or high\-end bespoke fashion.

\* Advanced pattern\-making skills.

\* Advanced draping skills.

\* Excellent fabric\-cutting ability.

\* Excellent machine\-sewing and hand\-sewing skills.

\* Strong understanding of garment construction and couture finishing.

\* Ability to work with delicate, expensive, and difficult fabrics.

\* Strong knowledge of women’s garment fitting and alterations.

\* Ability to understand a sketch and independently determine how the garment should be constructed.

\* Experience creating samples and prototypes from the development stage through the final garment.

\* Excellent attention to detail and precision.

\* Strong problem\-solving skills when translating creative designs into wearable garments.

\* Ability to work independently and manage several designs during collection development.

Preferred

\* Experience working in a couture atelier, bridal house, luxury fashion house, or bespoke studio.

\* Experience with evening gowns, draped dresses, corsetry, and complex silhouettes.

\* Knowledge of embroidery, embellishment, fabric manipulation, and hand\-applied details is an advantage.

\* Experience developing garments from original designer sketches rather than only following existing patterns.

What We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who is not limited to one technical area. The candidate should be capable of managing the complete garment\-development process:

Sketch → Draping / Pattern Making → Toile → Fitting → Pattern Correction → Cutting → Sewing → Couture Finishing → Final Garment

The right candidate should combine technical expertise with an understanding of design, proportion, movement, and luxury craftsmanship.

Pay: AED500\.00 \- AED5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai (Dubai)

**Location:** Remote  

**Type:** Full\-Time, Senior Executive  

**Industry:** Global E\-Commerce, DTC Consumer Products, Performance Marketing

 **THE ROLE**



Savvy Smart Deals is looking for a senior ecommerce operator to run the business end to end.

  

This is not a traditional General Manager role, and it is not a fit for someone whose background is primarily corporate operations, manufacturing, retail, consulting, brand marketing or supply chain.

  

YOU MUST HAVE REAL ECOMMERCE EXPERIENCE.

  

You must understand how to profitably run an online consumer business from product selection through customer acquisition, conversion, fulfillment and customer service.

 **You will own:**


* P\&L, revenue, margin and profit
* Ecommerce strategy and execution
* Product strategy and sourcing
* Online marketing and customer acquisition
* Paid media, affiliate traffic and performance marketing
* Shopify and direct\-response funnels
* Pricing, offers, bundles and upsells
* Conversion rate, AOV, CAC/CPA, ROAS and LTV
* Inventory, purchasing and forecasting
* Warehousing, fulfillment and logistics
* Customer service, refunds and chargebacks
* Budgets, analytics and forecasting
* Team performance and growth

  

You will effectively operate Savvy as the business owner and be responsible for turning products into profitable, scalable ecommerce businesses.

Candidates must have meaningful hands\-on experience in ALL of the following areas:

 **1\. ECOMMERCE / DTC**

* Strong understanding of Shopify, Amazon, marketplaces and/or direct\-response ecommerce
* Understand the full online customer journey from traffic through purchase, fulfillment and repeat purchase

* Supplier coordination
* Warehousing and fulfillment

* Approve pricing, bundles, discounts, upsells and recurring\-revenue opportunities
* Direct landing pages, advertorials, checkout, creative and video strategy
* Build relationships with affiliate networks, publishers, media buyers and traffic partners
* Negotiate payouts and commercial terms
* Secure profitable traffic at scale
* Expand winning offers into new channels and geographies

 **INVENTORY, FULFILLMENT \& CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE**


* Own inventory planning and purchasing decisions
* Prevent stockouts and excessive inventory
* Improve monetization of existing inventory through offers, bundles and upsells
* Coordinate suppliers, warehouses, fulfillment and logistics partners
* Ensure fulfillment problems do not interrupt sales
* Own customer\-service performance, returns, refunds and chargebacks
* Ensure service issues are identified and fixed quickly

 **PERFORMANCE \& ANALYTICS**



You must actively understand and manage:


* Revenue
* Gross margin
* Contribution margin
* Net profit
* CPA/CAC
* ROAS
* RPC
* CVR
* AOV
* Affiliate payouts
* Payment approval rates
* Refunds and chargebacks
* Inventory levels and turns
* Recurring revenue
* Customer lifetime value

Decisions must be based on economics and data, not opinion.

 **WHO WE WANT**



We want a proven owner\-type ecommerce operator, not a corporate administrator.



The ideal candidate has already run, built or materially scaled an ecommerce, DTC or direct\-response consumer\-products business and understands both sides of the business:

 **CUSTOMER ACQUISITION \+ OPERATIONS**

* Reviewing CPA and ROAS

* Negotiating with a supplier
* Reviewing inventory and forecasts

International ecommerce, Asian sourcing, Amazon, affiliate marketing, recurring revenue and payment optimization are strong advantages.

title: Interior Design Associate Director
description:
TGP International is looking for an experienced and highly creative Senior Associate / Associate Director to join its studio.

  

TGP International is a global hospitality consultancy based in London, Dubai, and Cairo. We partner with ambitious brands, clients, and entrepreneurs to turn their visions into successful hospitality experiences through concept development, interior design, branding and graphic design, advisory, franchising, operations, and project management. Our multidisciplinary team brings together interior designers, brand designers, strategists, advisors, chefs, and hospitality operators. This combination of creative and commercial expertise makes TGP an exciting environment for people who are passionate about food, hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences.

  

We are looking for someone who shares that passion. Someone inspired by the opportunity to create world\-class restaurants, bars, food halls, and hospitality destinations, and who understands how exceptional design can transform the guest experience.

  

While TGP is an established international consultancy, we retain a strong entrepreneurial spirit. This is a senior role within our Interior Design team, offering significant studio responsibility, client exposure, and the opportunity to contribute directly to exciting hospitality projects.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**Design Expertise**

* Deliver world class creative solutions across multiple small, medium, and large\-scale projects simultaneously, and across multiple geographies (UK, Europe, Asia and Middle East)
* Lead projects and the creative process from concept to delivery; with proven track record of strong design narrative where storytelling remains at the heart of the project throughout its development
* Lead and contribute hands\-on to concept development and design presentations, test fits, spatial planning, and 3D models, with a strong focus on guest experience and operational functionality
* Review detailed drawing packages, finishes and FF\&E specifications ensuring technical requirements and design intent are successfully co\-ordinated, including liaising effectively with clients, consultants, contractors and suppliers throughout the design and delivery process
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of design detailing, materials, finishes, fixtures and furniture, including fabrication and construction processes
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, makers, and other industry partners

 **Project Leadership \& Management**

* Take accountability for the successful creative and commercial delivery of projects to TGP’s quality standards
* Maintain oversight and remain actively involved and hands\-on throughout the entire project process, from initial concept through to design development, documentation, and delivery
* Make informed decisions regarding project resourcing, priorities, workflows, and allocation of responsibilities across internal teams including weekly resource tracking and coordination of project scheduling
* Manage projects effectively against agreed programmes, budgets, contractual scope of services, and commercial requirements
* Identify project risks and challenges early and work proactively with leadership team to resolve them
* Provide clear and timely reporting to the leadership team on project progress, resourcing, and key issues

 **Team Development \& Management**

* Foster a collaborative and supportive environment in which knowledge and best practice are openly shared
* Lead, mentor and train junior team members to support their professional and creative development, and maximise team performance and quality design output
* Support department resource planning, forecasting, project allocation and ad\-hoc department admin
* Manage workloads and workflows across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring teams are appropriately supported
* Contribute positively to TGP’s studio culture and help maintain an environment that encourages collaboration and creativity

 **Client Engagement**

* Proactively manage existing client relationships, ensuring that opportunities for repeat work are maximised
* Present creative concepts and design thinking clearly, confidently, and persuasively to senior client stakeholders
* Actively engage with opportunities to develop new business, enhancing internal and external communications via events, forums, and publications
* Support the preparation of fee bids, RFPs, and fee negotiations on projects

 **Software Proficiency**

* Adobe Suite
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* PowerPoint
* Microsoft Office


Experience with the following would be advantageous:

* Miro
* Asana

  

The role is based in our Covent Garden studio in London, with a hybrid working model of three days per week in the studio, and two days working remotely from home.

 **Requirements** **What we are looking for:**


We are looking for an accomplished hospitality designer and creative leader who combines exceptional design ability with strong project, team, and client leadership.


The successful candidate will have:

* 10\+ years' professional experience in interior design or interior architecture, with significant experience in hospitality and F\&B environments
* An outstanding portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative quality across restaurants, food halls, bars, and other hospitality and commercial environments having worked through Riba stages 1\-6
* A proven ability to develop emotive, narrative\-driven, and design\-led concepts and experiences, across projects of varying scales and geographies
* Strong creative leadership, with the ability to take projects from initial concept and storytelling through design development and delivery, including technical and construction expertise
* The confidence and experience to operate autonomously, with minimal supervision from leadership team
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, with experience developing and managing design teams
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of project programmes, budgets/value engineering, contracts, fees, and resourcing
* Excellent client\-facing, presentation, and communication skills
* A collaborative, adaptable, no\-ego approach, and a commitment to contributing positively to studio culture
* A bachelor’s degree in interior design, Interior Architecture or a related discipline from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional qualification
* The right to work in the UK

 **Benefits** **TGP International employee benefits:**

* Hybrid work arrangement: three days in the office and two days working remotely
* Company incentive scheme offering up to 5 to 10 per cent for introductions and 5 per cent for successful closures
* Remote work flexibility: one additional week per year to work remotely from your home country, which can be combined with up to two consecutive weeks of annual leave
* Structured professional development through a dedicated coaching and mentoring program

title: Client Marketing Director
description:
**About Bellrae Marketing**

Bellrae Marketing is a strategy\-led marketing agency that serves as an outsourced marketing department for established, growth\-minded businesses.

We bring strategy and execution together across SEO, social media, content, email marketing, paid media, and websites to build connected marketing systems designed to drive meaningful business results.

We're increasingly focused on the home and design industry, including design build firms, custom home builders, remodelers, interior design brands, and other established businesses where trust, expertise, visibility, and a healthy pipeline are critical to growth.

**About the Role**

As a Client Marketing Director, you are the client's senior marketing leader and report directly to Bellrae's COO.

You will work directly with founders and business leaders, lead their marketing strategy and plan, and serve as their primary point of contact at Bellrae. Behind you is a team of specialists across SEO, social media, email, content, paid media, and web. You will stay close to the work. You'll review deliverables, analyze performance, provide feedback, solve problems, communicate with clients, collaborate with specialists, and step in wherever your judgment and expertise are needed to keep the account moving forward.

You deeply understand your clients, their businesses, their clients, their goals, and what they're trying to accomplish. You connect the dots across marketing channels, provide clear direction to the team, review the work being produced, interpret performance, and continually determine what should happen next.

This is a role for someone who thinks two steps ahead. You don't wait to be told what to do. You notice the opportunity, identify the problem, ask the right questions, and move things forward.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the senior marketing leader and primary point of contact for a select portfolio of clients
* Build strong relationships with founders, CEOs, and key client stakeholders
* Deeply understand each client's business, goals, audience, sales process, pipeline, priorities, challenges, and competitive landscape
* Guide the overarching marketing strategy and plan
* Translate business goals into clear marketing priorities and direction for the team
* Lead client meetings with confidence, sound judgment, and a clear point of view
* Review reporting and analytics, identify what matters, and determine what should happen next
* Review client deliverables before they are presented or published, including social media content, emails, blogs, messaging, and campaigns
* Provide clear, actionable feedback to specialists and implementation team members
* Ensure SEO, social media, email, content, paid media, and web efforts work together toward the client's larger goals
* Stay ahead of client needs, opportunities, risks, and potential problems
* Maintain visibility into active work and ensure strategy makes its way into execution
* Communicate proactively with clients and the internal team
* Continually ask: What does this client need next?

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for an experienced, well\-rounded marketer with the judgment and confidence to lead both clients and a multidisciplinary marketing team.

You should:

* Have an “everything is figureoutable” mindset and naturally look for the path forward
* Use discernment to understand the difference between what a client says and what they actually need
* Have 10\+ years of marketing experience
* Have strong integrated marketing knowledge across SEO, social media, email marketing, content, websites, paid media, and analytics
* Understand SEO fundamentals and current best practices
* Keep your finger on the pulse of social media and understand what makes content capture attention and move people to action
* Have exceptional messaging instincts and a strong understanding of email marketing best practices
* Be able to interpret marketing data and turn it into meaningful recommendations
* Be an excellent, confident communicator who can lead a room
* Have strong marketing judgment and be comfortable making decisions
* Be highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities
* Think quickly and confidently on your feet
* Be proactive, self\-directed, and comfortable taking initiative
* Be able to solve problems without needing a how\-to manual
* Care deeply about knowing your clients and their businesses
* Be comfortable using project management tools; familiarity with ClickUp, Slack, and Basecamp is preferred

**Agency experience is strongly preferred.**

Experience in home and design, design\-build, construction, luxury services, or other high\-consideration service businesses is a plus.

**The Person We're Looking For:**

You are a people person. You genuinely enjoy getting to know clients, building relationships, understanding their businesses, and becoming someone they trust and want in the room.

You think like an owner. You don't look at an account and think, “What's on my task list?” You think, “If this were my business, what would I be paying attention to? What would concern me? Where is the opportunity? What should we be doing next?”

You're obsessed with results and helping clients win. Marketing activity for the sake of activity doesn't interest you. You want to understand whether the work is actually moving the business forward, and if it isn't, you want to figure out why and do something about it.

You think two steps ahead. You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs attention. You see it.

You have strong discernment. When a client tells you what they want, you listen carefully enough to understand what they're *really* saying and what the business actually needs.

You think quickly and confidently on your feet. You're comfortable leading a room, answering hard questions, making recommendations, and saying, *“I don't know yet, but I'll find out,”* when that's the right answer.

And above all, you know your clients. You know what they're trying to grow, what matters to them, what's happening in their pipeline, what they're worried about, what they're excited about, and where they're going because you can't lead someone's marketing without understanding their business.

**Position Structure**

This is a part\-time independent contractor role starting at $45\-$50/hour.

Client Marketing Directors are assigned a select portfolio of accounts based on experience, capacity, and account complexity. We intentionally keep portfolios limited so our Directors can become deeply immersed in their clients' businesses and provide true senior\-level marketing leadership.

You will be supported by Bellrae specialists and implementation resources across SEO, social media, email marketing, content, paid media, web, and administrative support.

Client meetings are generally recurring and scheduled well in advance. Outside of scheduled meetings, contractors have flexibility in when and where work is completed while meeting expectations for responsiveness, deadlines, communication, and quality.

**What Success Looks Like**

Your clients should think of you as their Marketing Director, not their contact at an outside agency.

They trust your judgment. They bring you into business conversations. They ask for your opinion. They know you're paying attention. And they feel confident that you and the Bellrae team understand where their business is going and what marketing needs to do to help them get there.

Pay: $45\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 25\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* How many years of marketing experience do you have, and how many of those years have been in an agency environment?
* Tell us about a client or business you helped grow. What were they trying to accomplish, what did you identify as the biggest marketing opportunity or problem, what did you recommend, and what happened as a result?
* When you inherit a new client account, what are the first things you want to understand before deciding what their marketing strategy should be?
* Do you have experience with ClickUp, Slack, and/or Basecamp?

title: District Manager
description:
**District Manager**
Location: CA District \- San Jose area
Reports to: COO
  

**About Somersault**
Somersault Operating Inc., the largest franchisee of The Little Gym, proudly operates 30 gyms across 8 states. With a vision to be the world’s leading youth enrichment franchisee, we develop exceptional leaders through top\-tier training, mentorship, and career growth. Our mission is to nurture children’s physical, mental, and social development by combining The Little Gym’s renowned curriculum with passionate instructors who bring energy, creativity, and heart—creating a magical space where learning, laughter, and confidence grow together. We seek leaders who actively pursue growth, both personally and professionally, and we’re committed to supporting that evolution.  

  

  

**About the Role**
As a District Manager, you lead with purpose, people\-first energy, and a strategic eye. You’ll inspire and support 6–12 gyms within your district, guiding Gym Directors and Program Directors to consistently deliver outstanding member experiences, achieve financial targets, and build thriving teams.  


  

Your presence in the gyms matters. You will spend several days each week visiting locations, connecting with teams, observing classes, and supporting your Directors in real time. You will bring clarity, positivity, and a strategic mindset to everything from enrollment and retention to labor management and member experience.  


  

Above all, you help create an environment where leaders feel supported, kids feel celebrated, and families feel connected to something truly special.  


  

**What You’ll Do**  

**Leadership \& Team Development**
* Lead, coach, and mentor Gym Directors and Program Directors to build strong, engaged, high\-performing teams that exhibit ownership of their location.
* Create a collaborative, uplifting culture across your district where leaders feel supported, challenged, and inspired.
* Provide ongoing training, feedback, and development to help each leader grow into the strongest version of themselves.
* Encourage accountability, ownership, and communication across all gyms.

  

  

**District Operations \& Performance**
* Oversee daily operations across 6–12 gyms, ensuring each delivers an exceptional program, safe environment, and warm family experience.
* Partner with Gym Directors to maintain operational excellence, brand consistency, and adherence to Somersault processes.
* Be present in the gyms at least 3 days per week, visiting locations based on business need, performance, and support priorities. This is not a remote position and presence in the gyms will vary week to week.

Step in to assist with in\-gym needs when necessary, including teaching classes or covering callouts during emergency staffing gaps.  
* 

**Strategic Planning \& KPI Management**
* Understand and manage key district KPIs, guiding each gym toward achieving targets for:
	+ Revenue growth
	+ Enrollment \& retention
	+ Labor percentage of revenue
	+ Conversion rates
	+ EBITDA and profitability
* Hold weekly Touch Bases with each Gym Director to review performance, opportunities, and growth plans.
* Use data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate them into clear, actionable strategies.

Actively share best practices and partner with other District Managers to support Somersault's growth as a whole.  
* 

**Sales, Marketing, \& Customer Experience**
* Ensure every gym maintains exceptional hospitality standards and family engagement.
* Support Gym Directors in building strong community relationships and driving enrollment.

Partner on local marketing efforts, sales coaching, and pipeline development.  
* 

**People \& Culture**
* Support recruiting, selecting, and developing leadership talent within your district.
* Foster a consistent Somersault culture rooted in growth, ownership, warmth, and fun.

Champion communication and collaboration across your gyms and with Somersault’s Executive Team.  
* 

**You’d Thrive in This Role If…**
* You love lifting others up and watching leaders grow under your guidance.
* You’re energized by visiting gyms, building relationships, and being hands\-on.
* You connect naturally with people—kids, parents, and teammates alike.
* You’re equal parts coach, strategist, and operator.
* You see challenges as opportunities to create solutions.
* You love building businesses that make a real impact on families and communities.
* You are ready to take the next step after excelling as a Gym Director.

**Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of leadership experience in a multi\-unit, fitness, youth enrichment, hospitality, retail, or service\-based environment; experience as a Gym Director or equivalent leadership role strongly preferred
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop managers and teams toward strong performance and engagement
* Strong understanding of business operations, including revenue growth, enrollment, retention, labor management, and profitability
* Comfortable using KPIs and business data to identify trends, solve problems, and create actionable plans
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills with the ability to connect with team members, families, and community partners
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple locations, priorities, and competing business needs
* Hands\-on leadership style with a willingness to spend significant time in gyms supporting teams and stepping in when needed
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset
* Passion for working with children and creating positive experiences for families
* Ability to travel between locations within the district at least 3 days per week
* Must be able to meet the physical requirements of an active gym environment, including standing for extended periods and occasionally lifting up to 50–60 pounds
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, but equivalent leadership experience will be considered

  

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive salary with performance based quarterly bonus
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Mileage reimbursement for travel days
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Long\-term disability and 401(k)
* Paid sick time, and company holidays
* Ongoing leadership training and development
* Opportunities for growth within Somersault

Employee discounts and a seriously fun work environment  
* 
All associated locations are independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchise, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of that franchise. All inquiries about employment at this franchise should be made directly to the franchisee, and not to The Little Gym Franchising Corporate.

title: Development Coordinator
description:
**Who We Are**



Children’s Center is a private, non\-profit child advocacy center accredited by the National Children’s Alliance. Children are referred to us by law enforcement agencies, child protective workers, parents, teachers, health care providers, and others concerned for their welfare. Our mission is to work with the community to end child abuse and neglect through assessment, treatment, and prevention. Our vision is to build a world where all children feel safe, valued, and heard.


**The Role**



The Part\-Time Development Coordinator plays a key role in our fund development efforts by supporting the administration of the development program; coordinating the appropriate gift receipting process; tracking and administering grant submissions and reports; managing and maintaining the donor database; supporting fundraising events and campaigns.
 

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**


* Manages databases by maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date records of donors, including contact information, giving history, communication preferences and contacts donors as necessary.
* Processes donations, ensuring accuracy and compliance with relevant financial regulations.
* Prepares and sends donation receipts to donors in a timely manner.
* Assists the development team to plan and execute fundraising campaigns, including direct mail, online giving, and special events.
* Assists in implementing donor cultivation strategies to engage and retain current donors.
* Sends thank\-you letters, acknowledgment emails, and personalized communications to express gratitude to donors.
* In collaboration with Grants Manager, maintains the grant calendar to track reporting requirements.
* Supports the planning and execution of fundraising events and campaigns, such as galas, charity auctions, and donor appreciation events.
* Coordinates volunteers to help support with development activities.
* Provides administrative support for the development team, including scheduling meetings, managing calendars, and preparing materials for presentations.
* Coordinates with donors and foundations to tour the center.
* Prepares reports for the development department and other departments as requested.
* Monitors department email accounts and responds to routine requests.
* Assists with social media and email communications.
* Assists in the collection of stories, content, images, videos, statistics, for use in presentations, social media, and collateral materials.
* In partnership with Development Director, manages the organizational brand and collateral materials.
* Performs other job duties as assigned.


**General:**


* Represents the mission, values, and programs of Children’s Center in all facets of the position.
* Maintains punctual, regular, and predictable attendance.
* Respectfully takes direction from supervisor.
* Maintains confidentiality.
* Works collaboratively in a team environment with a spirit of cooperation.
* Develops and maintains positive working relationships at all levels of the organization participating in our customer\-centered, caring, and collaborative culture.

**What We Require:**


* Associates degree and 2 years’ professional experience such as marketing, sales, customer service, development or in the non\-profit sector.
* Valid driver’s license, motorized vehicle, and vehicle insurance. Ability to transport self reliably to and from fundraising activities and events.
* Ability to communicate in English effectively, including clarity of thought, and grammar, both verbally and in writing.
* Basic proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Experience in or ability to learn CRM database management.
* Ability to do simple addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
* Ability to pay attention to details, prioritize tasks, problem solve, act with discretion and be gracious.
* Ability to work effectively alone, as part of a group, or as a team leader depending on context and needs.

**What We Prefer:**


* Public speaking experience.
* Experience and comfort in fundraising and data management.


**Additional Information:**


* This is a Part\-Time position, working 32 hours/4 days per week.
* This position allows for a hybrid work schedule where the employee can work remotely one day per week, based on the demands of the task and organization after the 90\-day Introductory Period has been successfully completed. Some evening and weekend hours are required for fundraising activities and event requirements.
* Our Center has a facility dog who is present in the workplace on a daily basis.


 **What We Offer:**



Children’s Center offers a competitive benefits package that includes PTO, paid holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance for you and your dependents, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Account, Employee Assistance Program, and 401(k). Wage: $27 to $28\.50 hour/ DOE.


Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every one of the qualifications as described in a job description. We are interested in finding the best candidate for our position; therefore, we encourage you to apply even if you do not think you meet all the qualifications.



Children’s Center is an EEO employer and is dedicated to an organizational culture of inclusivity. For more information about us, please visit: https://www.childrenscenter.cc/.

title: Director or Senior Director of Marketing
description:
**About The Chief of Staff Association**


The Chief of Staff Association (CSA) is the world's leading professional community for chiefs of staff. We exist to define, elevate, and advance the chief of staff role.
  

  

Through our membership programs, executive education, coaching, and talent services, we serve a global community of chiefs of staff and the organizations that rely on them. Our two core service lines, Membership and Talent, work in close partnership to deliver exceptional value to members, candidates, and client organizations alike.


If you are passionate about the impact a great chief of staff can have, and want to help shape the profession's future, we'd love to meet you.

**About The Role**


We are growing our marketing function at the CSA, this role will build and own top\-of\-funnel growth across both sides of the business: Membership, where our audience is individual chiefs of staff, and Talent, where our audience is client organizations. You will own our ideal customer profile and competitive insights, activate marketing channels and campaigns, drive registration and attendance across our calendar of events.


Reporting to the President, you will lead a team of two, keep paid and demand\-generation work aligned with CSA's brand guidelines and overall narrative, and work closely with the Talent business development team on pipeline and lead handoff. You will execute within a marketing budget approved by the President. Title and level, Director or Senior Director, will be set based on the successful candidate's experience.


This will be a full\-time, exempt role based in Denver, CO, working in a hybrid capacity with new hires committing to being onsite 2\-3 days a week. The role carries meaningful travel for events and industry engagements.

**Compensation**


Base salary: $160,000\-$185,000, depending on experience and level (Director or Senior Director), plus a performance\-based bonus tied to lead\-generation KPIs.


Full\-time employees also receive a monthly QSEHRA healthcare contribution, 401(k) participation, unlimited PTO, a full remote tech set\-up, co\-working access, and eligibility for monthly spot bonuses.

**Responsibilities**


Responsibilities may evolve as the function matures but generally align to the following core areas:

**Objectives of this Role**

* Collaborate with the business team to uncover insights for developing marketing and branding strategies for existing and new products.
* Oversee and grow the marketing function by identifying revenue opportunities among established clients and by securing new accounts.
* Identify short\- and long\-term scheduling and resource needs, including development and management of the annual marketing budget, profit\-and\-loss projections, and expenditures.
* Understand key performance metrics and tracking tools for market research, forecasts, competitor analyses, campaign results, and consumer trends, and translate results into actionable insights for the marketing team.
* Leverage the latest marketing AI tools to build an AI\-enabled marketing function.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Lead development of marketing strategy by working closely with clients, managers, creatives, content providers, and distribution partners to create effective plans focused on growing the audience for our products and services.
* Decide on channel activation strategy and manage execution (events, partnerships, sponsorships, etc.).
* Spearhead the execution of marketing campaigns, including test and control group segmentation, testing, tracking, results reporting, analyses, and recommendations.
* Manage conception, development, and implementation of marketing plans and strategy, product concepts, events, and promotional programs to drive customer interest and sales.
* Conduct meetings regularly with the sales team to review pipeline, resolve challenges, and brainstorm possible solutions, and provide training to ensure the team is consistently performing above standard.
* Attend conventions, conferences, and trade shows, preparing engaging displays and collateral as needed, and provide post\-event reports and analysis.

**Team Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead, manage, and develop a team of two: the Marketing and Events Associate and the Editorial Manager, setting clear priorities across editorial and campaign execution.
* Own the marketing technology stack supporting demand generation, campaign tracking, and reporting.
* Direct the work of external agencies and contractors supporting creative and paid media execution as needed.

**Project \& Budget Management**

* Bring project management discipline to campaigns, events, and cross\-functional initiatives, managing several concurrent work streams to deadline and within an approved budget.
* Report regularly to the President on marketing performance, budget, and team progress.

**You May Be A Fit If**

* You have a track record driving top\-of\-funnel growth in a professional services or membership\-based organization, ideally across both B2B and B2C customer segments.
* You have owned ICP definition and competitive positioning work that directly informed go\-to\-market strategy.
* You bring at least 6 years of marketing experience, including experience managing a team; candidates with 8\+ years may be considered for the Senior Director level.
* You bring strong project management discipline and can manage several concurrent campaigns, events, and stakeholders to deadline without losing quality.
* You are comfortable running paid acquisition campaigns (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads) and reading performance data to guide decisions on spend.
* You have driven registration and attendance for a marquee industry event alongside a broader events calendar.
* You lead with clarity and can set priorities across a small team, and collaborate naturally with people outside your own reporting line.
* You are energized by building a new function from the ground up, and by creating the systems and processes as you go rather than inheriting them.
* You are collaborative by nature and comfortable partnering closely with communications, sales, and executive stakeholders to align on messaging and priorities.

**What to Expect from Our Selection Process:**


The selection process is designed to assess the whole candidate and foster a mutual match for you and us. The process includes:

* Take The Predictive Index Behavioral Assessment
* 30 minute video screening interview with HR
* 30 minute video interview with hiring manager
* (2\-3\) 30 minute video block interviews with CSA colleagues
* Take home assessment \& in\-person interview
* References \& background check

**Note:** The Chief of Staff Association partners with The Predictive Index to align workstyles with the role. All applicants complete a quick, **two\-question, five\-minute** assessment—no right or wrong answers—and receive a profile readout upon completion.

title: Director, Brand & Integrated Marketing
description:
The Director of Brand \& Integrated Marketing will own MeUndies’ overall brand strategy and translate it into a cohesive marketing calendar, compelling campaigns, culturally relevant content, and consistent execution across every customer touchpoint. This leader will oversee the Brand and Social teams while owning integrated campaign planning, product\-launch briefing, content strategy, influencer and affiliate strategy, licensing marketing, and brand partnerships. This is not a role for someone who only develops high\-level strategy or manages agencies. We are looking for a hands\-on leader who can set the vision, write a strong brief, lead teams through execution, make decisions quickly, and measure what worked.
   

  

 This role will work closely with Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, Wholesale, and Licensing to ensure the entire organization is working from one clear brand and commercial calendar.
   

  

****Please note that this is a hybrid position of 4 days/week in our Los Angeles office.****
**What You'll Do**
* Brand Strategy and Positioning
* Own and evolve the MeUndies brand strategy, positioning, voice, visual identity, and cultural point of view.
* Ensure the brand remains distinctive, relevant, emotionally resonant, and consistent across DTC, retail, wholesale, and licensed products.
* Translate company and commercial priorities into clear customer\-facing narratives.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines while ensuring teams and external partners apply them consistently.
* Protect long\-term brand equity while helping the company achieve near\-term revenue goals.


 Integrated Marketing Calendar
   

  

* Own the master MeUndies marketing calendar across product launches, promotions, seasonal moments, collaborations, licensing, retail, and cultural opportunities.
* Create one source of truth connecting Brand, Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, and Wholesale.
* Lead cross\-functional planning meetings and ensure teams understand the objective, audience, message, deliverables, owners, deadlines, and success metrics for every major initiative.
* Identify calendar conflicts, missed opportunities, and resource constraints early.


 Campaigns and Product Launches
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end go\-to\-market process for major campaigns, product launches, collaborations, and licensed collections.
* Develop sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, business goals, channel needs, and a clear creative proposition.
* Ensure briefs include the audience, insight, objective, positioning, key message, deliverables, channel strategy, timing, budget, and measurement plan.
* Partner with Creative to develop concepts that are both brand\-building and commercially effective.
* Maintain launch readiness and hold cross\-functional teams accountable to deadlines and deliverables.


 Content and Social Strategy
   

  

* Own the integrated content strategy across organic social, campaigns, editorial, community, creators, partnerships, and emerging channels.
* Lead the Social team and establish clear channel roles, content pillars, publishing cadence, and platform\-specific strategies.

 Influencer, Creator, and Affiliate Strategy

* Build programs that generate both culturally relevant content and measurable customer acquisition.

 Licensing, Collaborations, and Partnerships

* Identify new collaboration and partnership opportunities that expand cultural relevance, audience reach, and commercial potential.

 Consumer Insights and Cultural Relevance

 Brand Communications and Community

* Identify opportunities for experiential marketing, events, pop\-ups, and earned cultural moments.

 Measurement and Hindsights
   

  

* Establish clear success metrics before every campaign and launch.

 Leadership and Operations
   

  

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Brand and Social teams.

* Manage relevant agencies, freelancers, creators, production partners, and brand budgets.
* Prioritize resources across competing initiatives and maintain a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* MeUndies operates from one clear and reliable integrated marketing calendar.
* Every major launch begins with a strong brief, launches on time, and concludes with a useful hindsight.
* The brand has a more recognizable and culturally relevant point of view.
* Social and content become more consistent, responsive, and commercially effective.
* Influencer and affiliate programs have clear strategies, economics, and measurement.
* Licensing and collaborations support both revenue growth and long\-term brand equity.
* Cross\-functional teams have clearer priorities, ownership, and deadlines.

 Irvington, NY

 Four days in office, one day remote

 Electric Picks is a rapidly growing jewelry brand known for trend\-forward styles, meaningful storytelling, and a lifetime guarantee. We’re entering an exciting new chapter and looking for a Director of Brand Marketing who can help define what the brand becomes next.

 The Director of Brand Marketing, will lead how Electric Picks shows up in the world.
 



 You’ll set the strategic direction while remaining close to the work—from developing campaign concepts and go\-to\-market plans to building partnerships, creating real\-world experiences, and shaping our social presence.

* Build scalable workflows and planning tools that improve clarity, accountability, and execution.

* 6\+ years of brand marketing experience, ideally within fashion, jewelry, beauty, lifestyle, luxury, or another consumer\-led category.

**Why Electric Picks** 




  





 You’ll join Electric Picks at a pivotal moment, with the opportunity to influence the brand’s long\-term vision while making an immediate impact. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, lead high\-visibility initiatives, and help build the campaigns, experiences, team, and operating foundation that support our next stage of growth.

title: Marketing Director
description:
The Marketing Director will serve as a key business leader who will inspire the marketing team and drive brand portfolio management, consumer communications and new product innovation launches, always incorporating a consumer\-centric perspective. The Director will be responsible for planning, development and implementation of marketing strategy , communications, innovation, renovation and portfolio management to exceed stated volume and profit objectives .
   

  

 The Marketing Director will oversee all aspects of Top Ramen® across all platforms, formats and sub\-brands under Top Ramen.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Consumer Insights and Business Acumen:**

**Innovation \& Renovation**
* Leads new product ideation and conceptualization for base brands.
* Builds 5\- year pipeline for brand portfolio including ideation, concept development, testing, technical assessments, financial assessments and project management.
* Leads packaging strategy to maximize brand equity at retail. Oversee the development of packaging graphics modification projects across agencies, internal cross\-functional teams, other segment leaders, and Sales to ensure smooth product/graphics development and launches.

**Branding And Communications**
* Directs product definition and packaging graphics direction.
* Ensures execution of packaging development projects.
* Guides marketing team and agencies in the planning of consumer advertising and promotions.
* Manages communications plan execution to deliver on\-budget, growth\-driving tactics in packaging, promotions, advertising, digital and social engagement.
* Works collaboratively with the Sales team to drive growth with retailers striving to reach the consumer and provides strategic direction in the development of selling and customer presentation documents.

* Directs growth in marketing team’s business acumen including consumer insights, project management, financials, forecasting, building a business case, customer relations and presentation skills.


**Evaluation Metrics**
* Brand or Sub\-brand $ Sales, $ Sales growth and Market Share, Margin targets
* Flawless execution of project deliverables
* On\-time timeline deliverables
* Brand Health scores ( e.g. share of voice, brand equity purchase funnel, household panel indicators)
* Innovation \& Renovation Concept Scores
* Innovation \& Renovation $ Sales and New product performance vs. forecast
* KPIs met on consumer campaigns and communication activities
* Self\-development and team development goals


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field
* 8\-10 years of brand management experience within the CPG industry
* 3\+ years managing direct reports
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
* Strong interpersonal


**Preferred**
* MBA


**Work Designation**
 This position is a Hybrid position at our Corporate Office which is 3 days onsite and 2 days remote.
   

  

**Pay Range**
 USD $180,000\.00 \- USD $210,000\.00 /Yr.
   

  

**About Us**
 OUR FOUNDER, MOMOFUKU ANDO
   

  

 There is only one company that can rightfully claim the Pinnacle of Noodledom. Only one company whose founder, faced with a Japanese food shortage after WWII, invented instant ramen and sparked a 3\-minute global revolution. Only one whose spirit of innovation continues to provide simple, nourishing delight to billions of people. Only one that has been loved around the world for more than 60 years. There is only one Nissin Foods.
   

  

 NISSIN IN THE U.S.
   

  

 On a trip to the U.S. in 1966, Mr. Ando noticed Americans curiously eating forkfuls of noodles out of cups, instead of using bowls and chopsticks. With that simple observation, the worldwide Cup Noodles® phenomenon was born. Shortly after, Nissin officially put down its roots in the U.S. In 1972, our Gardena, CA, plant started production of Top Ramen®—the first instant ramen manufactured and sold in the U.S. And ever since, Nissin Foods USA has launched a continuous stream of new and innovative products for hungry, noodle\-loving Americans.
   

  

 WHY NISSIN?
   

  

 Nissin Foods celebrates diversity and inclusion both in our brands and how we do business. Why? Innovation is best driven by diverse perspectives, which create unique results. Respect, steady professional growth, and quality work make our team stronger. We welcome quality folks to join Team Nissin and fulfill our mission to “make people happy by creating delicious, convenient and value\-oriented Asian\-inspired meal solutions.” If you celebrate innovation and love noodles, you belong here!

***A bit about this role:***


The Senior Manager, Document Services owns the oversight of daily operations and long\-term strategy, monitoring and development of the Document Services function. This role includes cross functional leadership and management of two distinct programs. Inbound Correspondence and Outbound Print Production.


You will serve as the connective point between Document Services and its cross\-functional partners, owns vendor relationships, manages the department budget on behalf of the Director and VP of membership operations, and is accountable for compliance across every document that enters or leaves the organization.


The Senior Manager, Document Services, role is a crucial bridge between membership and the core health plan and medical group functions. Ensuring that all documents flow in and out of the plan ensures that the plan has the most up to date and accurate information to ensure members get the right care and support.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

* Own the operating model for both Inbound Correspondence and Print Production: including intake, routing, turnaround standards, monitoring of operational signals, and escalation paths.
* Build capacity and forecasting plans: that anticipate membership growth and seasonal volume, rather than reacting to it.
* Build the tooling that makes change repeatable: Playbooks, intake, readiness trackers, adoption dashboards, KPIs. Anything we repeat should run as durable, self\-serve tooling. Leverage AI technology and reporting tooling to help analyze and interpret trends to drive change. Build monitoring and communication plans that give internal stakeholders early visibility into risk, delay, and volume shifts, replacing ad hoc updates with predictable reporting.

* Vendor Performance: Oversee daily operations with inbound mail and fax vendors, and outbound fulfillment vendors. Define and build out performance standards, scorecards, business reviews, and issue resolution processes. Including vendor budgeting and forecasting.

* 7\+ years in operations, correspondence management, print production, or a closely related function, including 3\+ years managing people, ideally including other managers.

* Strong analytical skills; able to build reporting from operational data and explain it to non\-operational audiences.

Human Resources

The Director, HRBP (R\&D) serves as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, aligning people strategies with business objectives. This role partners closely with leaders to drive organizational transformation and effectiveness, business\-focused talent strategies, leadership development, workforce planning and employee engagement. The HRBP operates as a trusted consultant, change leader and coach, leveraging data, business acumen and HR expertise to influence outcomes and enable sustainable growth.


The position reports directly to the Strategic HRBP R\&D and will work closely with colleagues across the matrix HR team including the HRBPs, HR COEs, HR Delivery and HR Operations.

**Essential Functions**

* **Strategic Business Partnership:** Partners with senior leaders / RDFLT members to understand business priorities and translate them into people strategies aligned with organizational goals. Provides thought leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning and leadership capability. Acts as a trusted advisor and coach to senior leaders on complex people and organizational matters.
* **Organizational Insight:** Develops a deep understanding of the organization, its strategy, priorities, customers and translates those into value\-added people priorities.
* **Matrix team:** Works effectively across the HR Operating model to support the successful delivery of functional projects and programs. Delivers an engaging experience for leaders and employees.
* **Organization Design:** Partners with senior leaders to drive organizational re\-design, developing strategies to both develop internal talent and build for future capability needs.
* **Change Management:** Leads and supports functional change management initiatives, including reorganizations and M\&A activity. Partners effectively with COEs to champion organizational values, employee engagement and the management of change initiatives.
* **Talent Management:** Inputs into and executes our business\-driven talent management process through effective collaboration with other HRBPs and the Talent Solutions team. Shares ideas and best practices and follows\-up on outcomes post\-talent review with functional leaders to develop and execute tactical interventions to deliver on our talent strategy.
* **Global HR Collaboration:** Collaborate with global HR teams to fully leverage the HR operating model and to effectively work across the HR matrix. Proactively seeks out opportunities for process improvements and implementation of best practices.
* **Data\-Driven Decision Making:** Proactively use data, metrics, and evidence to inform and drive decision\-making and change across key business areas.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* **Extensive HRBP Experience:** Progressive HR partnership experience with accountability for partnering, coaching and influencing senior leaders. Experience across HR functional areas including performance management, reward, talent acquisition, organizational development, change management.
* **Business Acumen \& Partnership:** Strong business acumen with the ability to understand financial, operational, and strategic drivers. Demonstrated experience leading organizational transformation, change and influencing senior leaders.
* **Adaptability \& Resilience:** Strong ability to navigate and thrive in an ambiguous environment, with the agility to pivot with changing priorities. Ability to cope with and recover from challenges quickly and appropriately prioritize a high volume of work.
* **Process and Project Management:** Strong process orientation and project management skills, with the capability to implement global solutions.
